name: Caskade
look: a sturdy tortoise whose shell is a banded oak barrel overgrown with grapevines and moss
entry: Caskade wanders mountain trails for decades, allowing rainwater and wild berries to ferment inside its oaken shell into a prized elixir.
how: Wild: common in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Its ability Oak Maturation doubles the effect of the Berry it holds and grows a new one two turns after it eats it.
